units.source_text: 然而，一年后，名人在《名人围棋全集》一书中的《布局选集》的讲评里，明确地写道：

en.t: However, one year later, in his commentary on Layout Selections in the Complete Works of the Meijin on Go, the Meijin wrote clearly:
Now Black 121 has seized an effective opportunity.

units.source_text: “要注意，如果犹豫（即在下白扳粘之后），黑121就可能失效。”

en.t: It should be noted that if one hesitates, that is, after White plays the hane and connection, Black 121 may lose its effectiveness.
